title: Two Sum
description:
Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return the indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target.

You may assume that each input has exactly one solution, and you may not use the same element twice.

You can return the answer in any order.
approach: Use a hash map from previously seen values to their indices. At index i with value x, first check whether target - x is already present; if it is, those two indices form the answer. Checking before insertion prevents reusing the same element. Each lookup and insertion is O(1) on average, so the total time is O(n).
